text.en:
Passively grants +20 Airborne Effectiveness to Hand Cannons and has an intrinsic Hand Cannon Holster.

Grants +100 Handling to Ready Speed, 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier and -40% Accuracy Cone Size for 4 seconds upon Readying your Hand Cannon.

Upon readying a Kinetic or Matching Hand Cannon with a Full Magazine:
<pve 60% Increased damage per Hit for 5.5 seconds. Maxes out at 600% after 10 Hits. />
Only works against PVE Combatants.

For Exotic Hand Cannon interactions, go to <link Court's Spreadsheet [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i1KUwgVkd8qhwYj481gkV9sZNJQCE-C3Q-dpQutPCi4/edit#rangeid=1312688627] />!

After the Buff runs out or you swap weapons:
You cannot gain stacks or reacquire the damage buff for 10 seconds.
text.ko:
핸드 캐논 총집이 기본으로 내장되어 있습니다.
핸드 캐논을 꺼내는 순간 4초 동안 준비 속도가 100 증가하며 지속 시간 배율이 0.6으로 증가, 공중 효율 20 증가, 그리고 착탄 범위가 40% 좁아집니다.

물리 속성이나 장착한 하위 속성과 일치하는 속성의 핸드 캐논을 준비할 시:
<pve 5초 동안 한발 마다 피해가 60% 식 증가하며 10발에서 최대 600% 피해 증가가 부여됩니다./>
수호자에겐 적용되지 않습니다.

경이 핸드 캐논의 피해 배율을 보고 싶으시면 <link 이 차트를 확인하세요 [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1i1KUwgVkd8qhwYj481gkV9sZNJQCE-C3Q-dpQutPCi4/edit#rangeid=1312688627] />

버프의 지속 시간이 끝나거나, 무기를 바꾸거나, 5초 동안 사격했을 시:
버프를 10초 동안 얻을 수 없습니다.

Grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 100 Handling for Ready Speed
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size for 4 seconds upon Readying your Hand Cannon

Upon readying a Fully Loaded Kinetic or Matching Hand Cannon inside PVE:

(Some Exotic Hand Cannons don't follow these numbers or have special rules)

After the Buff runs out, or you swap weapons:
Cannot gain stacks or reacquire the damage buff for 10 seconds.

Grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• -40% Accuracy Cone Size for 4 seconds on Readying

In PVE, upon readying a fully loaded Kinetic or Super Element-matching Hand Cannon:
Grants 60% increased Direct Hit damage per hit for 6 seconds. Maxes out at 600% after 10 Hits.

<yellow Eriana's Vow /> only receives 30% increased damage per hit. <yellow Sturm />'s Overcharged Rounds, <yellow Malfeasance />'s Explosive Shadow, and <yellow Hawkmoon />'s Paracausal Shot are unaffected by the buff.

Swapping weapons or the buff running out grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff for 10 seconds, preventing you from gaining damage increase stacks.

Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).


'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%.

<yellow Eriana's Vow /> only receives 30?% increased damage per Stacks. <yellow Sturm />'s Overcharged Rounds, <yellow Malfeasance />'s Explosive Shadow, and <yellow Hawkmoon />'s Paracausal Shot are unaffected by the buff.

While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping weapons or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff for 10 seconds. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster'.

• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%.

<yellow Eriana's Vow /> only receives 30% increased damage per Stack. <yellow Sturm />'s Overcharged Rounds, <yellow Malfeasance />'s Explosive Shadow, and <yellow Hawkmoon />'s Paracausal Shot are unaffected by the buff.

While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.

Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%.

• <yellow Eriana's Vow /> only receives 30% increased damage per Stack (300%). 
• <yellow Sturm />'s Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%). 
• <yellow Hawkmoon />'s Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%). 
• <yellow Malfeasance />'s Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.

While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.

Passively grants the following benefits while a Hand Cannon is readied:
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• 6.25% increased Sprint Speed
• 33% increased Slide Distance

Readying a Hand Cannon grants 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 6 seconds (for the PVE-only benefits of the perk, consider this the 0th Stack).

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants the following benefits to Hand Cannons:
• 100 Ready Speed Handling
• 0.6x Ready Animation Duration Multiplier
• 30% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• PVE ONLY: Direct Hits grant a Stack of 'Illegally Modded Holster'. Maximum of 10 Stacks.

'Illegally Modded Holster' grants 45% increased Direct Impact damage per Stack, maxing out at 450%. Boss-Tier Enemies take 33% decreased damage from Lucky Pants shots.

• <purple Uncivil Discourse /> only recieves 30% increased damage per stack.
• <yellow Sturm />'s Overcharged Rounds only receive 11% increased damage per Stack (110%). 
• <yellow Hawkmoon />'s Paracausal Shot receives 5% increased damage per stack upon being fired (50%). 
• <yellow Malfeasance />'s Explosive Shadow is unaffected by the buff.


While at 'Illegally Modded Holster x7' or higher:
Swapping to a non-Hand Cannon weapon or the buff expiring grants you the 'Out of Luck' debuff. 'Out of Luck' prevents you from reacquiring 'Illegally Modded Holster' for 10 seconds.
